description: This file defines structures and API functions related to parsing, forging, and handling LLDP payloads within IEEE 1905.1/1a stack implementation. It declares a structure representing LLDP payload data and functions for parsing packets, creating packets from structures, comparison, cleanup, and visiting elements for debugging or processing.

methods.name: parse_lldp_PAYLOAD_from_packet
methods.description: Parses a network packet stream containing LLDP data (Ethernet payload) to extract and return a structured representation of the payload TLVs: Chassis ID, Port ID, Time To Live. Returns NULL on error.

methods.name: forge_lldp_PAYLOAD_from_structure
methods.description: Constructs a packet stream from a given LLDP payload structure, suitable for transmission. Returns NULL on error.

methods.name: free_lldp_PAYLOAD_structure
methods.description: Frees all memory allocated within an LLDP payload structure.

methods.name: compare_lldp_PAYLOAD_structures
methods.description: Compares two LLDP payload structures for equality, returning 0 if they contain identical data.

methods.name: visit_lldp_PAYLOAD_structure
methods.description: Traverses an LLDP payload structure, invoking a callback on each element for processing or debugging.

ctags.name: list_of_TLVs
ctags.pattern: /^    uint8_t *list_of_TLVs[MAX_LLDP_TLVS+1];  \/* NULL-terminated list of pointers to TLV$/
